rules: Direct live entity page fields override search-discovery snippets.
Minimum and maximum conflicts are preserved exactly and never silently reordered.
Search-cache fields are not promoted after a live cache miss.
Rows with an official end date before verification are historical controls.
Student accommodation capacity remains source semantics and is not silently converted to conventional dwellings.
POINT is an official source location, not a canonical parcel polygon.
Canonical parcel ID and future-growth score remain null until canonical geometry intersection.
